name: pr_checkout
description: Check out an existing PR by number into the repo (gh pr checkout). Input: repoPath, number, repo? (upstream owner/name), branch?, force?.

repoPath.description: Local git checkout to check the PR out into.

repo.description: Upstream repository (owner/name or URL) that owns the PR; needed when repoPath's origin is a contributor fork where the PR number doesn't exist.

branch.description: Local branch name to create for the checkout. Defaults to gh's own naming when omitted.

force.description: Force-reset an existing local branch of the same name. Accepts a boolean or a truthy string ('1','true','yes','on').

number.description: PR number that was checked out.

branch.description: Local branch name now checked out.
